title: A Foolish Wish
lines: Gus is a pup with one big wish.
He wants to swim just like a fish.
That is a foolish wish for a pup.
Gus ran and jumped in the pond.
The pond was cold and greenish.
Gus sank fast. Meg had to pull him out.
Now Gus just sits and looks at fish.

questions.listenFor: To swim like a fish. The first two lines say it.

questions.ask: Who pulled Gus out of the pond?
questions.listenFor: Meg. Line seven, near the end.
Either answer works. Listen for a because.
